verified_facts.text: Kivotos Mykonos sits at the far end of a wind-protected private beach reserved for hotel guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Kivotos Mykonos enjoys a rare and privileged setting, nestled at the far end of a wind-protected, private beach — a truly private stretch of shoreline reserved exclusively for our guests.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's cove has views over Ornos Bay.
verified_facts.excerpt: This secluded cove offers uninterrupted views over Ornos Bay

verified_facts.text: The suites and villas follow classic Cycladic design and step down the rocky hillside toward the hotel's private beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: In complete harmony with nature’s handiwork and the classic Cycladic design, the hotel’s 40 suites and villas range in picturesque fashion down the rocky hillside towards their own private beach

verified_facts.text: The Signature Suite 130 degrees has a private pool with a front made entirely of glass.
verified_facts.excerpt: is the only Suite in Mykonos that features a Private Pool with a front completely made from glass, offering you the unique feeling of floating in the air.

verified_facts.text: The Two Bedroom Suite with Pool combines two interconnecting suites, each with its own queen bedroom, living room and bathroom.
verified_facts.excerpt: Two (2) Bedroom Suite with private pool in Mykonos is compiled of two interconnecting open plan Luxury Suites, each one with its own Queen bedroom, living room and bathroom.

verified_facts.text: The Honeymoon Suite has sea views and an open-air jetted tub.
verified_facts.excerpt: This unique in design and amenities Honeymoon Suite offers the ideal romantic getaway, complemented by the marvelous sea views and open-air jetted tub.

verified_facts.text: Guests can arrange a private meal, intimate gathering or small cocktail party by the beach, in a separate private area or on the hotel's yacht.
verified_facts.excerpt: Kivotos offers you the option of enjoying a private meal, attending an intimate gathering or a small cocktail party either by the beach, in a separate private area or onboard the hotel’s yacht.

verified_facts.text: An a la carte Mediterranean restaurant sits on a shaded patio by the pool overlooking Ornos Bay.
verified_facts.excerpt: It is nestled in a charming shaded patio, right by the pool, overlooking the azure waters of Ornos bay.

verified_facts.text: The main saltwater pool is on the lower level, just above the private beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: The main saltwater pool of Kivotos in Mykonos Greece is located on the lower level, right above the hotel’s private beach.

verified_facts.text: The main pool area has underwater music, a Jacuzzi and a swim-up bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: the view of the pool, the underwater music, the Jacuzzi™, and the swim-up bar create a refreshingly dreamy oasis of relaxation.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's spa is ONAR Spa.
verified_facts.excerpt: Welcome to ONAR SPA at Kivotos Mykonos

verified_facts.text: The private beach is a curve of white sand right below the lower-level pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Kivotos has a private beach for the exclusive use of hotel guests, right below the lower level pool. This charming wind-protected curve of white sand

verified_facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler lists Kivotos Hotel in its Readers' Choice Awards 2022.
